integrity: Proof is self-contained in RESULT.md; independently reconstructible symbolic/rational checks in verify.py. Finite tests are not used as universal proof.
scientific_limitations: No claim about internal RK4 stages or nonlinear systems.
No extension to heterogeneous weights or general graphs.
The RK4 scalar absolute-stability endpoint itself is classical, not new.
Historical originality has not been independently established; a thematically relevant full text was unavailable.
scientific_scope: Classical fourth-order RK4 endpoint for unweighted finite complete multipartite diffusion Laplacians with at least two nonempty parts and arbitrary positive integer part sizes.
title: Sharp RK4 positivity equals spectral stability on complete multipartite diffusion networks
